Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Whose path do I ask for in every prayer?

Prophets, the truthful, witnesses, the righteous: we ask for their path in every prayer. What did they share?

Part 1 of 3

﴿صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

Quran · Al-Fatihah 1:7

Translation

Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

Original · Ancient Greek

καταλιπόντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν, ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ Βοσὸρ ὃς μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἠγάπησεν

2 Peter · 2:15

World English Bible

﴿وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۚ وَحَسُنَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ رَفِيقًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And whoever obeys Allāh and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allāh has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:69

In every prayer you ask for the path of people the Fatiha does not name. Left undefined, each person would fill it with whomever they love. But the Quran explains itself in almost the same words: those God has blessed, then four descriptions: prophets, the truthful, witnesses and the righteous. Notice that this is no closed list of names. Prophethood is God's gift, but the verse promises their company to whoever obeys, and the last door is wide: the righteous.

A question for you

Whom do you picture when you say this line in prayer?

If you sayThe prophets.
ThenThey head the list in 4:69, and the list goes on past them.
If you sayThe Prophet's family.
ThenThey hold a great place in Muslim hearts, and that door has its own Step.
If you sayI had never thought about it.
ThenA line repeated for a lifetime. The thinking can begin today.

Part 2 of 3

﴿أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩﴾

Translation of the meaning

Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

Quran · Maryam 19:58

Translation

Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

Original · Hebrew

וַיְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃

the Torah (Exodus) · 34:8

World English Bible

What joins those named in this verse? Lineages come first: the descendants of Adam, Noah and Abraham. But the verse does not stop there. It gives one mark: when the verses of the Merciful are recited to them, they fall down bowing and weeping. Their blessing is more than descent; it is a heart turned to God. If this is what joins them, it is also what you are asking for when you ask for their path.

A question for you

Which mark in the verse is nearest to you?

If you sayA tie to good people.
ThenA blessing worth thanks, and the verse goes on to what the heart does.
If you sayBeing moved when the Quran is recited.
ThenThen you are close to the description. Hold on to that.
If you sayI do not yet find this in myself.
ThenThat honesty is a beginning. The prayer you say is a request for exactly this.

Part 3 of 3

﴿أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."

Quran · Al-An'am 6:90

﴿قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, [O Muḥammad], "If you should love Allāh, then follow me, [so] Allāh will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

Quran · Aal Imran 3:31

Translation

You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

Original · Hebrew

וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃

the Torah (Deuteronomy) · 6:5

World English Bible

If you love a righteous person, what is the truest proof of it? These verses answer: walk as they walked. The Fatiha asks God to guide you along their path, so the request goes to Him, and they are the example. We ask God for their way. This does not oppose love; it is love's aim: a love that takes you to God, as it took them.

A question for you

What exactly does the Fatiha's prayer ask of you?

If you sayTo ask God for their way.
ThenThat is what the line says. It leaves you to say how to walk it.
If you sayTo love them.
ThenLove is a root, and 3:31 adds what love bears: following.
If you sayTo become like them.
ThenThat is the sense of 6:90: follow their guidance.

The same in the other books

Translation

For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
